name: Fujisawa's Mother
source:
The mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c76871]Takuya[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c49119]Chisato[/url]. She raises alone her two children and she works very hard to ensure the financial comfort of her family. 

She doesn't spend much time with her children because of her work (which makes her very sad) but she devotes the little of her free time to her childrens, making meals or bentos as soon as she can. She relies heavily on her eldest son to look after her youngest daughter Chisato.

[spoiler]She does appear visually and is sexually involved only in the harem ending where Takuya lets their mother surprise Chisato and him during their sexual intercourse. Then he and Chisato force her to have sex with them to strengthen their family ties.

Shocked at first, she doesn't struggle too much and her children begin to caress her. Having not had sex for years, her body quickly succumbs to pleasure against her will. When Takuya begins to penetrate her and when Chisato starts to stimulate her clitoris, she succumbs little by little to the pleasure of the flesh.

Later, she fell in love and also becomes the girlfriend of her son.[/spoiler]
